from fate.components.core.nn import Sequential
from fate.components.core.nn import Adam

from fate.components.core.nn import BCELoss

def main(config_file):
    # Load config
    config = pipeline.load_config(config_file)
    guest = config['role']['guest'][0]
    host = config['role']['host'][0]
    backend = config['backend']
    work_mode = config['work_mode']

    # Define pipeline
    pipe = pipeline.Pipeline().set_initiator(role='guest', party_id=guest)
    pipe.set_roles(guest=guest, host=host)

    # Reader for guest and host
    reader_0 = Reader(name="reader_0")
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        table=config['data']['guest_train'])
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        table=config['data']['host_train'])

    # DataTransform for guest and host
    data_transform_0 = DataTransform(name="data_transform_0")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        with_label=True, output_format="dense")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        with_label=False)

    # Intersection
    intersect_0 = Intersection(name="intersect_0")

    # HeteroNN configuration
    # Guest bottom model
    guest_bottom = Sequential(layers=[
        Dense(units=64, activation='relu', input_shape=(None,)),  # input_shape will be inferred
        Dense(units=32, activation='relu')
    ])
    # Host bottom model
    host_bottom = Sequential(layers=[
        Dense(units=64, activation='relu', input_shape=(None,)),
        Dense(units=32, activation='relu')
    ])
    # Interactive layer
    interactive_layer = InteractiveLayer()
    # Guest top model
    guest_top = Sequential(layers=[
        Dense(units=1, activation='sigmoid')
    ])

    hetero_nn_0 = HeteroNN(
        name="hetero_nn_0",
        epochs=10,
        batch_size=128,
        learning_rate=0.01,
        optimizer=Adam(),
        loss=BCELoss(),
        interactive_layer=interactive_layer,
        guest_bottom_model=guest_bottom,
        host_bottom_model=host_bottom,
        guest_top_model=guest_top,
        callback_param={
            "early_stopping": True,
            "patience": 3,
            "save_best_model": True
        }
    )

    # Evaluation
    evaluation_0 = Evaluation(name="evaluation_0", eval_type="binary")

    # Add components to pipeline
    pipe.add_component(reader_0)
    pipe.add_component(data_transform_0, data=reader_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(intersect_0, data=data_transform_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(hetero_nn_0, data=intersect_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(evaluation_0, data=hetero_nn_0.output.data)

    # Compile and fit
    pipe.compile()
    pipe.fit(backend=backend, work_mode=work_mode)

    # Print summary
    summary = pipe.get_component("hetero_nn_0").get_summary()
    print("HeteroNN Summary:")
    print(summary)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser("FATE HeteroNN Pipeline Example")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=str, required=True, help="Path to config file")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.config)
